assessment.basis: All 10 production captures were considered. The capture log reports two AI synthesis outputs and eight source-only or no-synthesis outcomes. NVIDIA was headline/context level with no source-linked counter-evidence; Microsoft contained a stale quote and claims without counter-evidence. Remaining runs lacked usable synthesis, and some results had no attributable sources or poor relevance. This score reflects observed usefulness and evidence quality, not a verified claim-accuracy rate.

rubric.evidence_quality: Both synthesis cases show material evidence concerns; no claim-level labels or source adjudications were supplied.
rubric.source_and_relevance: Not adjudicated for all ten events; September CPI visibly included off-topic sources.
rubric.usability: Eight of ten runs fell back to source-only output or no usable results.

protocol_quality_score.reason: The published protocol requires two independent reviewer labels plus adjudication for every displayed factual claim. These were not created. The reproducible scorer correctly rejects incomplete inputs.

limitation: This single-reviewer assessment does not replace source-by-source factual verification, independent reviews, adjudication, or protocol task-time measurement.
